Ravi S: Hey all, just joined and trying to follow the quickstart. Getting a 403 when opening https://console.staging.redwood. Need to toggle a feature flag for my "first-week" task. Who should I ping?
DevEx Bot: Welcome Ravi! Please open an access request here: https://internal.redwood/requests and include your Okta username. Staging-only admin is typically granted for 5 business days.
Ravi S: Filed request REQ-6219 (okta: ravi.s@redwood.dev). Included approval from my manager Maya.
Maya L: Approved — accepted in the ticket. @Infra Team can you do the staging admin grant? I only want staging access for now.
Infra Team: We can. Staging-only role is "console-admin:staging"; FF operator is a separate entitlement "ff-operator". Add both to the ticket if you need to toggle flags.
Ravi S: Added "ff-operator" to the same ticket. Also, is there a short checklist to verify access after it's granted?
Onboard Bot: Quick checklist: 1) Visit https://console.staging.redwood 2) Confirm Admin menu visible 3) Navigate to Admin -> Feature Flags 4) Try toggling a non-critical test flag (name: onboarding_test_flag) 5) Run health curl: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status``` and expect "ok".
Infra Team: Granted console-admin:staging and ff-operator to ravi.s@redwood.dev for 5 days.
Ravi S: I can see Admin -> Feature Flags now and toggled onboarding_test_flag. Health check returned {"status":"ok"}. :tada: Thanks!
Maya L: Nice. Heads up: never toggle prod flags unless security signs off. If you need prod-read-only for tests we can create a demo clone.
Ravi S: Got it — staying in staging. Closing REQ-6219 after I finish the task. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
DevEx Bot: If you want the step-by-step for using the FF UI, see https://go/redwood-devex/ff-ux and ping #devex for a short walkthrough.
